premises.text: Mainstream social media harms kids via predatory algorithms, addiction loops, strangers, data risks, and inappropriate content
premises.evidence_span: social media has some challenges, like predatory algorithms, addictive behavioral loops that reinforce toxic mindsets, strangers and creepers, not the Minecraft kind, sliding into DMs, compromised personal data, and inappropriate videos and messaging

premises.text: Kids' digital literacy and entertainment/education needs are unmet by incumbent platforms
premises.evidence_span: whose needs are not being met. They're exposed to inappropriate content. Their messaging needs are not met. The incumbents have left a soft spot in the market for products for kids

premises.text: Platform offers kid-friendly creator tools and co-creation that support developmental self-expression
premises.evidence_span: Between features, kid-friendly versions of the creator tools that we see on major platforms, and all those dance challenges, hamster videos, magic tricks that kids create and share, that taps into essential developmental pieces of navigating emotions and self-expression

premises.text: Guided authentic profiles and socially/emotionally appropriate communication with curriculum-based troll training
premises.evidence_span: we guide them to have authentic profiles. And we guide them to be socially and emotionally appropriate in their communication. So the only trolls that exist here are ones that we intentionally introduce as part of our guided curriculum

premises.text: Parents can customize and stage-gate tools by age via parental controls and guided curriculum
premises.evidence_span: we provide parental tools that can be turned on and off, because kids shouldn't have access to all of the tools right off the bat. So in this way, parents can customize the platform for the age and stage of their child

premises.text: Expert-curated/moderated age-appropriate content with pause moments and verified parental consent
premises.evidence_span: it is curated and moderated by experts, by adults trained in developmental psychology and in our editorial guidelines to ensure that everything that is on the platform is appropriate for kids

premises.text: GTM starts with age-appropriate content beta, parent networking, brand partnerships, then invitation-based social graph
premises.evidence_span: we're intentionally starting with content for our beta, because this addresses a major pain point for parents, age-appropriate content. But it also ensures that Between is engaging from the start, allowing us to jumpstart network effects

Mindful kid social platform with parental staging

value.text: Family-friendly social media that teaches kids thoughtful digital engagement
value.evidence_span: Betweened is how we course correct social media for kids around the world, ensuring that the millions of kids, my daughter included, grow up thoughtful and practiced in all that they do

causal_links.evidence_span: They need to be taught how to engage and how to disengage with technology
a platform that will support kids' digital literacy while providing the entertainment and education, the interaction that they crave
addresses a major pain point for parents, age-appropriate content
